- Scott → Austin (from statement 1)
- Austin → Larry (from statement 5)

\[ \text{Samantha} \rightarrow \text{Douglas} \rightarrow \text{Megan} \rightarrow \text{Scott} \rightarrow \text{Austin} \rightarrow \text{Larry} \rightarrow \text{Paul} \rightarrow \text{Donald} \]

Therefore, the correct answer is:
<ANSWER>4</ANSWER>
